fusions.name: Unravel
fusions.desc: Bats a ball of yarn at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 7 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Velvet Ambush
fusions.desc: A muffled weapon strike that deals 28 damage and is always a critical hit. It makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it [Suppressed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Muffled Tread
fusions.desc: Binds your feet in cloth and veils you for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Stitch in Time
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
